name: Inma-jou Dasshutsu-ki
source:
Dedicated to paizuri lovers worldwide.

One day you are abruptly kidnapped by succubus!
Can you stave off the temptation and escape their castle?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE154341.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
献给全世界乳交爱好者。

一天，你突然被魅魔绑架！
你能抵挡诱惑，逃出她们的城堡吗？

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE154341.html]DLsite英文版[/url]）
